title: RFID Wooden Keyfob — FSC Wood, NTAG or MIFARE Chip
summary: The RFID Wooden Keyfob pairs an FSC-certified wood body with a contactless RFID or NFC inlay reading at 1–4 cm typical range. It is designed for membership, access-control, and luxury-branding programs that need a tactile, sustainable alternative to plastic keyfobs without compromising on chip choice or read range. Chip options span NTAG, MIFARE, ICODE, and EM families; MOQ is 100 pieces with a 12–18 working day reorder lead time.
heroPoints: FSC-certified maple, bamboo, or beech wood body with a stainless-steel split ring.
Compatible with most NTAG, MIFARE, ICODE, and EM chip families.
Read range 1–4 cm with NTAG 21x; up to 6 cm with MIFARE Plus EV2 on a quality reader.

brief.label: Specification
items: Material: FSC-certified maple, bamboo, or beech (custom species available).
Dimensions: 35 × 30 × 4 mm typical; 28 × 28 × 5 mm on request.
Hardware: stainless-steel split ring (24 mm or 30 mm).
Chip options: NTAG 213/215/216, NTAG 424 DNA, MIFARE Classic 1k, MIFARE Plus EV2, MIFARE DESFire EV2/EV3, ICODE SLIX, EM4100/4305.
Frequency: 13.56 MHz NFC/HF; 125 kHz LF on EM chips; dual-frequency on request.
Read range: 1–4 cm typical, up to 6 cm on high-power readers.

brief.label: Marking
items: Laser engraving (recommended): logo, member name, sequential number, QR.
Color-fill engraving (epoxy resin) for premium programs.
UV print for full-color artwork on flat surfaces.

brief.label: Sourcing
items: MOQ: 100 pieces per chip family and engraving combination.
Encoding included: UID lock, NDEF, custom block writes.

brief.label: Best-fit applications
items: Hotel and resort member keyfobs (premium and eco-positioning programs).
Gym, fitness, and country-club membership credentials.
Office and residential access control with sustainability story.
Luxury automotive and sailing club access.

sections.title: Why a wood keyfob instead of plastic or metal
sections.intro: ABS plastic and zinc-alloy keyfobs dominate the access-control market because they are cheap, durable, and easy to engrave. Wood keyfobs cost more, dent more easily, and need a sealed finish for outdoor use. They earn their place when the program needs a sustainability narrative or a premium tactile feel that plastic and metal cannot deliver.
bullets: Biodegradable wood body; recyclable stainless-steel hardware (24 mm or 30 mm split ring).
FSC chain of custody documented for sustainability audits.
Distinct hand feel: the 35 × 30 × 4 mm body is warmer and quieter than ABS or zinc alloy.
Laser-friendly: engraves crisply without ink lamination.
Brand-positioning value: luxury, hospitality, eco-conscious memberships.

sections.title: Where wood keyfobs underperform
sections.intro: Honest about limits: a wood keyfob is not the right choice for every program.
bullets: Outdoor or wet environments: humidity warps unsealed wood. Use lacquer or skip wood.
Heavy-use industrial: ABS or zinc lasts longer in trades and industrial keyrings (24–36 months versus 12–18 for wood).
Cost-sensitive bulk: PVC or ABS at high volume undercuts wood by 30–50%.
Aggressive print artwork: wood grain shows through full-color UV print.
Long-distance UHF: wood adds dielectric mass that detunes UHF antennas.

sections.title: How we test before shipping
sections.intro: Every encoded keyfob passes the same QC pipeline as our plastic keyfobs, with a wood-specific finish check.
bullets: 100% functional read test on every encoded keyfob.
Hardware torque test on the split ring attachment.
Lamination and lacquer cure: 48 hours before engraving or shipping.
Engraving QC: visual check on depth, contrast, registration.
Pack-out: bulk poly bag, individual sleeve, or branded box on request.

faq.question: Can the wood keyfob open hotel-lock readers?
faq.answer: Yes, with the right chip. MIFARE Plus EV2 and MIFARE DESFire EV3 wood keyfobs work with Saflok, VingCard, Onity, Salto, and Häfele Dialock systems. Read range is shorter than a flat card because of the keyfob form factor; 2–4 cm is realistic on standard hotel readers.

faq.question: How long does the wood keyfob last on a daily-use keyring?
faq.answer: Expect 12–18 months before noticeable wear from pocket use, friction against keys, and humidity. ABS or zinc-alloy keyfobs last 24–36 months in the same conditions. Wood is a deliberate trade-off: shorter life for tactile and sustainability value.

faq.question: Is dual-frequency available?
faq.answer: Yes, on request. We can pair an HF chip (NTAG, MIFARE, ICODE) with a 125 kHz LF chip (EM4100 or EM4305) in the same wood body. Dimensions and lead time both increase. Confirm reader requirements before ordering.

faq.question: Will the engraving fade?
faq.answer: Laser engraving carbonizes the wood and does not fade in normal use. UV print and color-fill engraving wear over time depending on handling. Sealed lacquer slows wear on all marking methods.
